screens.intent: Cross-submission conflict summary, deadline alerts, activity feed, new-guidance banner
Active dossiers index with conflict-count badges
Document editor with amber annotations, URL-param-driven side panel and memo drawer

urlParams.name: panel
urlParams.purpose: When set to an ImpactItem id, opens GuidanceSidePanel pre-scrolled to that item

urlParams.name: memo
urlParams.purpose: When set to an ImpactItem id, opens DecisionMemoDrawer over the document backdrop

children.name: DocumentViewer
children.intent: Render section prose with amber-underline annotations at annotationOffset/annotationLength ranges from ImpactItem records
children.propContract: { section: SubmissionSection; impactItems: ImpactItem[]; activeItemId?: string }

children.name: GuidanceSidePanel
children.intent: Slide-in panel showing one ImpactItem's guidance excerpt, agent rationale, confidence badge, assignee, accept/reject actions
children.propContract: { item: ImpactItem; excerpt: ChangedExcerpt; assignee?: User; onClose: () => void }

children.name: DecisionMemoDrawer
children.intent: Memo drawer over the document backdrop showing draft memo, escalation flags, approval signature line
children.propContract: { item: ImpactItem; existingDecision?: DecisionRecord; onClose: () => void }

children.name: ConflictBanner
children.intent: Top-of-page strip with open conflict count and a CTA to expand the side panel
